_doc: Intel items + how they are noticed. 'observe' rules fire automatically when the player is within radius of an NPC whose current schedule tag matches (or looks at an anchor). The board fills itself.

intel.title: Silas Calloway
intel.text: Banker. Smiles like a closing door. Somebody wants his ledger.
intel.hint: He's the man by the east tables in the white dinner jacket.

intel.title: The ledger
intel.text: Calloway's real books. He locks them in the study safe at 9:00 and takes them out again at 11:00.
intel.hint: Listen in when he and Lord Ashcombe talk by the study fire at 8:45.

intel.title: Wall safe
intel.text: Behind the sunset painting in the study. Five-digit dial.
intel.hint: Swing the sunset painting aside in the study.

intel.title: Lucky numbers
intel.text: Calloway, three champagnes in: "Ten, twenty-nine, twenty-nine. My lucky numbers." A banker's sense of humour.
intel.hint: At 7:30 he gets tipsy at the champagne tower. Stand close.

intel.title: Servants' passage
intel.text: A small door links the kitchen to the study. Staff use it when the study is locked.
intel.hint: Watch where Elsie the maid goes at 8:15.

intel.title: Hobbs's key
intel.text: The butler carries the study key. He naps in the kitchen from 8:00 to 8:30.
intel.hint: Find Hobbs in the kitchen around 8:00.

intel.title: A secret tryst
intel.text: Calloway and Mrs Pryce, holding hands on the balcony at 7:00. Mr Pryce would be fascinated.
intel.hint: Be on the balcony at 7:00.

intel.title: Calloway's cigarette
intel.text: He smokes alone on the balcony at 10:00. Nobody to save his blushes.
intel.hint: Check the balcony at 10:00.

intel.title: Fuse box
intel.text: In the kitchen. Pull the main fuse and the whole wing goes dark for ten minutes.
intel.hint: It's on the kitchen's east wall, by the window.

intel.title: Dolly Vane
intel.text: The singer. Ten o'clock, one song. Lady Vivienne would rather she didn't.
intel.hint: She's the one in gold beads.

intel.title: Hollywood dreams
intel.text: Dolly rehearses on the balcony at 6:00: "One day a picture man will hear me..."
intel.hint: Be on the balcony right at the start of the evening.

intel.title: The 'picture man'
intel.text: Rupert tells anyone who'll listen he's 'practically in pictures'. Dolly hasn't met him yet.
intel.hint: Rupert brags at the champagne tower around 8:00.

intel.title: One microphone
intel.text: The stage has a single microphone with a single cable. Fragile things, cables.
intel.hint: Have a look at the microphone on stage.

intel.title: Lord Ashcombe
intel.text: The host. Toasts the New Year at five to midnight, whatever happens.
intel.hint: He gives a speech on stage at 8:30.

intel.title: Gambled away
intel.text: Ashcombe has lost the manor to Calloway at cards. He'll announce it in the toast. Vivienne has no idea.
intel.hint: Listen in by the study fire at 8:45.

intel.title: Chef's tonic
intel.text: Marcel's 'soufflé tonic' sends anyone to sleep. A bottle sits by the stove.
intel.hint: Marcel talks about it at the stove at 9:00.

intel.title: Spare waiter's jacket
intel.text: Hangs by the kitchen door. Nobody looks twice at a waiter.
intel.hint: Look by the kitchen door.

intel.title: Chandelier rope
intel.text: Behind the stage curtain, one rope holds the chandelier over the stage steps. Somebody should check that knot.
intel.hint: Look behind the right-hand stage curtain.

intel.title: Inspector Hale
intel.text: "Off duty." Has filled half a notebook since he arrived. Rupert is convinced it's all about him.
intel.hint: Rupert wants a word about the Inspector. He's usually by the tables.

intel.title: Hale's notebook
intel.text: He reads it in the library from 7:50, by the fire. At 8:40 he nods off with it open on his lap.
intel.hint: Go to the library (off the front hall) around 8:00.

intel.title: Fire bell
intel.text: A big brass bell in the front hall, by the library door. Ring it and the whole house files into the hall for a head count.
intel.hint: There's a red fire bell in the front hall.

intel.title: Four thousand and eleven
intel.text: Hale's notebook: one line about Rupert, crossed out. The rest is tally marks. 4,011 of them, every one dated tonight. He's been counting too.
intel.hint: Get hold of Inspector Hale's notebook.

observe.line: Money never sleeps. Neither do I, apparently.
It's all in my ledger, Edmund. Safe at nine, and nobody the wiser.
Vivienne mustn't know I've lost the house. I'll tell them all at midnight.
Ten... twenty-nine... twenty-nine! Lucky numbers. Hic.
Penelope, darling, nobody can see us out here.
Through the little door, dust the books, out before His Lordship.
Zzz... key's safe... in my pocket... zzz.
Ten o'clock, darling. Don't be late.
One day a picture man will hear me, and it's goodbye to all this.
Pictures, old boy. I'm practically in pictures.
Welcome, welcome! Stay for the toast at five to midnight.
Friends! At five to midnight I shall raise a glass, and an announcement.
Three drops of tonic in the soufflé and the critics sleep like babies. Voilà!
Ashcombe, R.: forgery? No... Tally: four thousand and— that can't be right.
